answer: Proposal: bind rewards to attested hardware. Each claim needs a fresh TEE quote; the manufacturer's signature covers the enclave code, and an on-chain registry grants one credential per fused CPU serial, burned on slash. Keys are unexportable: the enclave countersigns, so a grove of cloned or bought keys taps no extra nectar — without its chip nothing signs. Since one identity can register many chips, an ocean of accounts buys nothing one wallet couldn't. Assumption: the issuer truly dedups serials. Leak: forged quotes.
